scope: Exact reference-kinematics review of the proposed centered 50 ms ramp. No new controller trace or implementation batch.
preview_requirement: The centered ramp starts at 0.225 s, 25 ms before a replan arriving at 0.25 s. It needs advance knowledge or an explicitly earlier admission.
same_task_assessment: It changes the velocity and position reference. Error measured only relative to the new reference cannot establish repair of the original fixed task.
causal_fixed_endpoint_obstruction: At t=0.25 s the original q2=2.5 m/s^2. Reaching q2=0 at t=0.5 s with |j|<=10 requires integral j=-2.5, the lower bound over 0.25 s. Therefore j=-10 almost everywhere on that interval. A nonzero continuous ramp from +10 cannot preserve that acceleration endpoint and deadline within the same jerk limit.
restart_requirement: Explicitly allow a timing/endpoint/jerk-limit change or prove a causal endpoint-matched feasible reference on a broader horizon; compare methods on the same accepted task and error definition.
